meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML. Use this whenever the user wants WeChat article formatting, article preview, WeChat draft upload, image generation for articles, cover or infographic generation, image-post creation, writer-style drafting, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or current discovery of supported providers, themes, prompts, and layout modules. Also use for unpublished Zhihu, CSDN, Toutiao, or Tencent Cloud Developer Community drafts through a browser. Use for product introductions, encyclopedia articles or entry drafts, and writing tailored to platforms or search targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 草稿排版成公众号文章,自动配图、拟标题并上传到草稿箱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常在公众号、知乎或头条发文,想让排版和配图一步到位
copy.tagline_en: Format Markdown drafts into WeChat-ready articles with images and drafts uploaded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post often on WeChat, Zhihu or Toutiao and want formatting and images handled.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 md2wechat 命令行:把 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML、预览文章、上传草稿、生成封面或信息图、给出标题候选,还能按创作者风格改写和去 AI 痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要求做公众号排版、预览或上传草稿,或生成封面与信息图、要标题建议等写作任务时,它会接管。

say.text: 把 article.md 转成公众号 HTML 并预览
say.note: 先 inspect 再 preview,不上传

say.text: 给这篇文章生成一张封面图
给这篇文章出几个标题候选
say.note: 只输出提示请求,不定稿

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs the md2wechat CLI: it converts Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, previews articles, uploads drafts, generates covers or infographics, suggests titles, and rewrites or humanizes text.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for WeChat article formatting, preview or draft upload, cover or infographic generation, title suggestions, or similar writing tasks.

say_en.text: Convert article.md to WeChat HTML and preview it
say_en.note: inspect first, then preview; no upload

say_en.text: Generate a cover image for this article
Suggest a few titles for this article
say_en.note: emits a prompt only, no file changes
